task.pr_title: :bug:  fix number formatter not listening to state changes

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Since `getNumberFormat` returns an object literal, this will return a different value on every render and cause excessive rerendering. I would recommend fetching each of the state values separately, then using `useMemo` to construct the number format.

evidence.thread_resolution: MatissJanis: Good shout. Added `reselect` that will take care of this. We should port all other selectors to it too.
